sessionId.description: The session: one call while one agent is on it.

callId.description: The call, as the REST API's /v3/voice/calls knows it. It stays the same when the call moves to a person.

agentId.description: The agent, as the REST API's /v3/voice/agents knows it.

callRef.description: Chosen by the agent for a tool.call, unique within the session, and repeated in its tool.result.

party.description: One end of a call, in the shape of the REST API's call parties.

kind.description: user, number, conference, agent or anonymous. Sent may add kinds.

value.description: The app user's identity, the E.164 number, the room name or the agent id. Absent for anonymous.

code.description: Stable and machine-readable. Sent may add codes.

message.description: For people. It may change without notice.

resumeToken.description: A secret that moves one session to a new connection, once. Opaque: keep it out of URLs and logs.

resume.description: How to resume the session on a new connection. See Resuming sessions in docs/protocol.md.

window_ms.description: How long Sent keeps the session for a resume after its connection is lost, or after it ends.

audioStream.description: The number in the header of the session's binary audio frames, unique among the sessions open on the connection.

frameCount.description: How many of the other side's frames for the session were read. Resuming sessions in docs/protocol.md says which frames count.
